title: Try the 50/30/20 rule
description: Put 50% of your income towards needs, 30% towards wants and 20% towards savings or paying off debt.

title: Pay yourself first
description: Move money into savings the day your income arrives, before you spend on anything else.

title: Track small daily spending
description: Coffee, snacks and delivery fees add up. Logging every expense for a month shows where your money really goes.

title: Build an emergency fund
description: Aim for three to six months of essential expenses in an easy-to-reach account so surprises don't become debt.
